meta.title: Ondra GUI Operation
meta.description: A single-step decision loop for the graphical interface: one action judged at a time, one ticket issued at a time, and a ticket burns on first use. All three safety nets are real. The danger-zone blacklist uses normalised rectangles, so a resolution change cannot shift it. The app allow-list treats an empty list as deny-all rather than as a forgotten setting. Action confirmation thresholds, a daily budget and a rate limit cover typing and key presses. Form red line: stop immediately when a filled form is detected; when the form state is unknown, only typing is escalated, because a stray click is usually undoable while typing into a half-filled form is not. Risk classification can actually return readonly, unlike the previous implementation that never did and therefore made even observation pass through the approval gate. Observation and execution go through a GuiRunner port: there is no in-repo evidence for screen capture or synthetic events, so none is invented. The audit records shape rather than content: no body text, only a character count, and coordinates quantised to a ten-pixel grid. approve is deliberately not a tool, because a model that can approve its own tickets turns tiered approval into a monologue. Disabled by default, and only observation is enabled out of the box.
